Shingrix (zoster vaccine recombinant, adjuvanted) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-441190  
Guideline Name 
Shingrix (zoster vaccine recombinant, adjuvanted)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/5/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Shingrix*  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Vaccine is being used for prevention of herpes zoster (shingles)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Both of the following:  


--- PDF page 1585 ---
Page 1585 
 
 2.1 Patient is between 18 to 49 years of age  
 
AND 
 
 2.2 Patient is or will be at increased risk of herpes zoster due to immunodeficiency or 
immunosuppression caused by known disease or therapy  
Notes  
*Prior authorization is not required for patients 50 years of age and old
er.  
PA TEAM NOTE: If PA is approved, please flip Medicaid Flag to Y an
d flip all of the following flags to 'Y' in order for claim to pay: GPI List, 
GPI Period Fills, GPI Contingent Therapy, GPI Diagnosis List.
